items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I played the alto and the soprano, and Ed Powers played the tenor.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know, you get his horn. See, the horn, I mean, it's really right. Yeah. Well, what... Ed Powers was a guest. Yeah. He was a guest. I see.
And he... What's... You said you were playing the soprano and alto, so... Yeah. What instrument did he play?
